import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MOD1 = 998244353;
    static final int MOD2 = 1000000007;
    static long total_value;
    static int[] digit_array = new int[15];
    static int[] base_array = new int[15];
    static int total_ans = 0;
    static int[] diff_vals = new int[15];
    static int[] q1_list = new int[1000010];
    static int[] q2_list = new int[1000010];
    static long[] q2_sum_arr = new long[1000010];

    static long get_number(int[] arr, int len) {
        long res = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i <= len; i++)
            res = res * 10 + arr[i];
        return res;
    }

    static long calculate_rank(int[] arr, int len) {
        long total = 0;
        for (int d = 1; d <= digit_array[0]; d++) {
            for (int i = 1; i <= Math.min(len, d); i++) {
                for (int j = (i == 1 ? 1 : 0); j < arr[i]; j++) {
                    long leftPart = 0, rightPart = 0;
                    for (int p = 1; p < i; p++)
                        leftPart = rightPart = leftPart * 10 + arr[p];
                    leftPart = rightPart = leftPart * 10 + j;
                    for (int p = i + 1; p <= d; p++)
                        leftPart = leftPart * 10;
                    rightPart = rightPart * (long) Math.pow(10, d - i) + (long) Math.pow(10, d - i) - 1;
                    rightPart = Math.min(rightPart, total_value);
                    if (leftPart <= rightPart)
                        total += rightPart - leftPart + 1;
                }
            }
            if (d <= len)
                total++;
        }
        return total;
    }

    static int computeF(int[] arr, int len) {
        long res = (-get_number(arr, len) + calculate_rank(arr, len)) % MOD1;
        if (res < 0) res += MOD1;
        return (int) res;
    }

    static void dfs_range(int start, int end, int[] q, int v) {
        if (start == end) {
            for (int i = 0; i <= 9; i++)
                q[++q[0]] = (int) ((v + 1L * i * diff_vals[start]) % MOD1);
            return;
        }
        for (int i = 0; i <= 9; i++)
            dfs_range(start + 1, end, q, (int) ((v + 1L * i * diff_vals[start]) % MOD1));
    }

    static void perform_update(int len, int idx, int val) {
        int[] backup = new int[15];
        System.arraycopy(digit_array, 0, backup, 0, 15);
        digit_array[idx] = val;
        for (int p = idx + 1; p <= len; p++) digit_array[p] = 0;
        int baseVal = computeF(digit_array, len);
        for (int p = idx + 1; p <= len; p++) {
            digit_array[p] = 1;
            diff_vals[p] = (computeF(digit_array, len) + MOD1 - baseVal) % MOD1;
            digit_array[p] = 0;
        }
        if (len - idx == 0) {
            total_ans = (total_ans + baseVal) % MOD2;
            return;
        }
        if (len - idx == 1) {
            for (int p = 0; p <= 9; p++)
                total_ans = (total_ans + (baseVal + 1L * p * diff_vals[len]) % MOD1) % MOD2;
            return;
        }
        int mid = (len + idx) / 2;
        q1_list[0] = 0;
        q2_list[0] = 0;
        dfs_range(idx + 1, mid, q1_list, baseVal);
        dfs_range(mid + 1, len, q2_list, 0);
        Arrays.sort(q2_list, 1, q2_list[0] + 1);
        long sumQ2 = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i <= q2_list[0]; i++)
            sumQ2 = (sumQ2 + q2_list[i]) % MOD2;
        for (int i = 1; i <= q1_list[0]; i++) {
            int p = lowerBound(q2_list, 1, q2_list[0], MOD1 - q1_list[i]);
            total_ans = (int) ((total_ans + sumQ2 + 1L * q2_list[q2_list[0]] * q1_list[i]) % MOD2);
            total_ans = (int) ((total_ans + 1L * (q2_list[0] - p + 1) * (MOD2 - MOD1)) % MOD2);
        }
    }

    static int lowerBound(int[] arr, int start, int end, int target) {
        int low = start, high = end;
        while (low < high) {
            int mid = (low + high) / 2;
            if (arr[mid] >= target)
                high = mid;
            else
                low = mid + 1;
        }
        return low;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        total_value = Long.parseLong(br.readLine().trim());
        long m = total_value;
        int len = 0;
        while (m > 0) {
            digit_array[++len] = (int) (m % 10);
            m /= 10;
        }
        // Reverse the array
        for (int i = 1; i <= len / 2; i++) {
            int temp = digit_array[i];
            digit_array[i] = digit_array[len - i + 1];
            digit_array[len - i + 1] = temp;
        }
        digit_array[0] = len; // store length at index 0
        for (int d = 1; d <= len; d++) {
            for (int i = 1; i <= d; i++) {
                int l = (i == 1 ? 1 : 0);
                int r = (d == len ? digit_array[i] - 1 : 9);
                for (int j = l; j <= r; j++) {
                    if (j != digit_array[i]) perform_update(d, i, j);
                }
            }
            total_ans = (total_ans + computeF(digit_array, d)) % MOD2;
        }
        System.out.println(total_ans);
    }
}
